"""Isolated failure-path probes for the maintenance script repair; no model calls."""
import argparse
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

BASE = Path('/Users/adam/Developer/propulsion/maintenance/skill-refactor-2026-10-01')

def module(name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, BASE / (name + '.py'))
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value

blind = module('blind-packets')
conf = module('conformance')
runner = module('run-comparisons')

class MaintenanceProbes(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='maintenance-probe-')
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)

    def make_record(self, prompt='Natural single paragraph task.'):
        records = self.root / 'records'
        record = records / 'one'
        (record / 'state').mkdir(parents=True)
        (record / 'state/input.txt').write_text('unchanged input\n')
        (record / 'response.md').write_text('Observed response.\n')
        run = {'skill': 'sample-skill', 'case': 'one', 'prompt': prompt,
               'commands': [], 'rubric': ['Preserve input.'], 'exit': 0,
               'before': {}, 'after': {}}
        (record / 'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(run))
        output = self.root / 'packets'
        identifier = hashlib.sha256(str(record / 'run.json').encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        return records, record, output, output / identifier

    def build_packets(self, records, output):
        with patch.object(sys, 'argv', ['blind-packets', str(records), str(output)]), redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as stream:
            blind.main()
        return json.loads(stream.getvalue())

    def test_natural_and_historical_prompt_extraction(self):
        for task in ['Single paragraph.', 'Essential first paragraph.\n\nAdditional constraint.']:
            self.assertEqual(blind.task_from_run({'skill': 'sample-skill', 'prompt': task}), task)
            prefix = 'Use $sample-skill from .agents/skills/sample-skill/SKILL.md. Resolve composed skills from .agents/skills in this workspace.'
            for suffix in ['\n\n', ' Read the entire named SKILL.md before acting.\n\n']:
                self.assertEqual(blind.task_from_run({'skill': 'sample-skill', 'prompt': prefix + suffix + task}), task)
            self.assertEqual(blind.task_from_run({'skill': 'sample-skill', 'prompt': 'Complete this request without loading reusable skills.\n\n' + task}), task)
        self.assertEqual(blind.task_from_run({'task': 'Exact task.', 'prompt': 'Irrelevant.', 'skill': 'sample-skill'}), 'Exact task.')

    def test_natural_packet_and_incomplete_recovery_preserve_old_output(self):
        records, record, output, packet = self.make_record('Essential.\n\nConstraint.')
        packet.mkdir(parents=True)
        (packet / 'old-partial').write_text('historical partial output')
        result = self.build_packets(records, output)
        self.assertEqual(result['packets'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((packet / 'evidence.json').read_text())['task'], 'Essential.\n\nConstraint.')
        archives = list(output.glob('.*-incomplete-*'))
        self.assertEqual(len(archives), 1)
        self.assertEqual((archives[0] / 'old-partial').read_text(), 'historical partial output')
        self.assertTrue((packet / 'packet-provenance.json').is_file())

    def test_copy_failure_does_not_publish_or_replace_partial_packet(self):
        records, record, output, packet = self.make_record()
        packet.mkdir(parents=True)
        (packet / 'old-partial').write_text('keep')
        with patch.object(blind.shutil, 'copytree', side_effect=OSError('injected copy failure')):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, 'injected copy failure'):
                self.build_packets(records, output)
        self.assertEqual((packet / 'old-partial').read_text(), 'keep')
        self.assertFalse((packet / 'evidence.json').exists())
        self.assertEqual(list(output.iterdir()), [packet])

    def test_changed_source_rejected_without_modifying_complete_packet(self):
        records, record, output, packet = self.make_record()
        self.build_packets(records, output)
        before = runner.digest_tree(packet)
        (record / 'response.md').write_text('changed response')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Source changed for complete packet'):
            self.build_packets(records, output)
        self.assertEqual(before, runner.digest_tree(packet))

    def test_legacy_complete_packet_preserved_and_freshness_limit_reported(self):
        records, record, output, packet = self.make_record()
        self.build_packets(records, output)
        (packet / 'packet-provenance.json').unlink()
        before = runner.digest_tree(packet)
        (record / 'response.md').write_text('updated source')
        result = self.build_packets(records, output)
        self.assertEqual(result['preserved_legacy_packets_without_freshness_provenance'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(before, runner.digest_tree(packet))

    def make_catalogue(self):
        skill = self.root / 'skills/sample-skill'
        (skill / 'agents').mkdir(parents=True)
        (skill / 'SKILL.md').write_text('---\nname: sample-skill\ndescription: Handle a recurring bounded task.\n---\n\nRead the supplied input and return its result.\n')
        (skill / 'agents/openai.yaml').write_text('policy:\n  allow_implicit_invocation: false\n')
        original = self.root / 'original'
        shutil.copytree(self.root / 'skills', original)
        (self.root / 'README.md').write_text('Use $sample-skill.\n')
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text('Fixture instructions.\n')
        metadata = self.root / 'metadata.json'
        metadata.write_text(json.dumps({'sample-skill': conf.parsed_metadata(skill)}))
        return skill, original, metadata, self.root / 'conformance.json'

    def run_conformance(self, original, metadata, output):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BASE / 'conformance.py'), str(original), str(metadata), str(output)], cwd=self.root, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)

    def test_conformance_observes_real_validation_and_binds_metadata_hashes(self):
        skill, original, metadata, output = self.make_catalogue()
        result = self.run_conformance(original, metadata, output)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        data = json.loads(output.read_text())
        validation = data['checks']['packaging_validator']
        self.assertEqual(validation['passed'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(validation['warnings'], 0)
        self.assertTrue(validation['results'][0]['report']['valid'])
        for name, digest in data['skills'][0]['metadata_source_sha256'].items():
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256((skill / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), digest)

    def test_stale_frontmatter_rejected_without_overwriting_result(self):
        skill, original, metadata, output = self.make_catalogue()
        path = skill / 'SKILL.md'
        path.write_text(path.read_text().replace('recurring bounded task', 'different bounded task'))
        output.write_text('historical result')
        result = self.run_conformance(original, metadata, output)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('Stale metadata for sample-skill', result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(output.read_text(), 'historical result')

    def test_stale_adapter_rejected(self):
        skill, original, metadata, output = self.make_catalogue()
        (skill / 'agents/openai.yaml').write_text('policy:\n  allow_implicit_invocation: true\n')
        result = self.run_conformance(original, metadata, output)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('Stale metadata for sample-skill', result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(output.exists())

    def test_real_packaging_failure_prevents_certification(self):
        skill, original, metadata, output = self.make_catalogue()
        with (skill / 'SKILL.md').open('a') as stream:
            stream.write('\nRead [missing](references/missing.md).\n')
        result = self.run_conformance(original, metadata, output)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('Packaging validation failed', result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('references/missing.md', result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(output.exists())

    def test_exit_zero_with_invalid_validator_report_rejected(self):
        validator = self.root / 'validator.js'
        validator.write_text('console.log(JSON.stringify({valid:false,errors:["fixture failure"],warnings:[]}));')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Packaging validation failed'):
            conf.packaging_validation(validator, self.root)

    def runner_args(self):
        previous = self.root / 'previous'
        candidate = self.root / 'candidate'
        previous.mkdir()
        candidate.mkdir()
        return argparse.Namespace(work=self.root / 'work', output=self.root / 'runs', previous=previous,
                                  candidate=candidate, timeout=0.2, fresh_agents=False, isolate_catalogue=False)

    def test_unknown_arm_rejected_before_creating_workspace(self):
        args = self.runner_args()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unknown comparison arm'):
            runner.run_case({'skill': 'sample-skill', 'id': 'bad'}, 'typo', args, 1)
        self.assertFalse(args.work.exists())
        cli = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BASE / 'run-comparisons.py'), 'absent.json', '--previous', str(args.previous), '--candidate', str(args.candidate), '--output', str(args.output), '--work', str(args.work), '--arms', 'typo'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(cli.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn('invalid choice', cli.stderr)

    def test_stubborn_timeout_records_artifacts_and_reaps_process(self):
        args = self.runner_args()
        args.timeout = 2
        stub = '#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport pathlib, signal, sys, time\nsignal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)\npathlib.Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("-o")+1]).write_text("partial response")\npathlib.Path("observed.txt").write_text("before timeout")\nsys.stdin.read()\nprint("{\\"type\\":\\"turn.started\\"}", flush=True)\ntime.sleep(60)\n'
        case = {'skill': 'sample-skill', 'id': 'stubborn', 'task': 'Natural task.', 'activation': 'natural',
                'files': {'stub-bin/codex': stub}, 'setup_commands': ['chmod +x stub-bin/codex'],
                'rubric': ['Preserve evidence.'], 'mode': 'workspace-write'}
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            data = runner.run_case(case, 'none', args, 1)
        self.assertTrue(data['timed_out'])
        self.assertTrue(data['termination_escalated'])
        self.assertEqual(data['exit'], -signal.SIGKILL)
        record = args.output / 'sample-skill-stubborn-none-1'
        self.assertTrue((record / 'run.json').is_file())
        self.assertEqual((record / 'response.md').read_text(), 'partial response')
        self.assertEqual((record / 'state/observed.txt').read_text(), 'before timeout')
        self.assertEqual(data['task'], 'Natural task.')

    def test_timeout_kills_descendant_when_parent_exits_on_sigterm(self):
        pidfile = self.root / 'child.pid'
        heartbeat = self.root / 'heartbeat'
        child = 'import os,signal,time,pathlib; signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN); pathlib.Path(' + repr(str(pidfile)) + ').write_text(str(os.getpid()))\nwhile True:\n pathlib.Path(' + repr(str(heartbeat)) + ').write_text(str(time.monotonic_ns()))\n time.sleep(0.02)'
        parent = 'import subprocess,sys,time; subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c",' + repr(child) + ']); sys.stdin.read(); time.sleep(60)'
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', parent], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, start_new_session=True)
        self.addCleanup(lambda: self.kill_group(process.pid))
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
        while not pidfile.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.01)
        self.assertTrue(pidfile.exists())
        timed_out, escalated = runner.communicate_trial(process, 'prompt', 0.1, termination_grace=0.1)
        self.assertTrue(timed_out)
        self.assertTrue(escalated)
        self.assertIsNotNone(process.returncode)
        self.assertTrue(heartbeat.exists())
        time.sleep(0.1)
        stopped = heartbeat.read_text()
        time.sleep(0.15)
        self.assertEqual(stopped, heartbeat.read_text(), 'child heartbeat continued after group kill')

    @staticmethod
    def kill_group(pid):
        try:
            os.killpg(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
